title: Reliability-based Topology Optimization using Large Deviation Theory
summary: Reliability-based topology optimization (RBTO) requires repeated estimation of small failure probabilities and their gradients, making conventional nested Monte Carlo approaches computationally prohibitive for large scale structural problems. We propose an RBTO framework that integrates large deviation theory~(LDT) with stochastic gradient descent~(SGD) to address this challenge.
